certification_reason: The assignment mandate is to demonstrate a buildable (front, first-deferred) PAIR with both legs' closes AND both open interests observed with proper lag, per market per date. The materialised native_contract_layer CSVs contain held contract only; the deferred contract must come from Norgate Futures database (27,451 dated symbols). While evidence confirms (a) Norgate Futures database is reachable, (b) contract naming pattern is correct (CL-2026U/-2026V encoding verified), (c) roll dates are observable (CL 2026-08-14), and (d) the last_oi=0.0 anomaly is real (2026-08-21), the CRITICAL UNMET GATE is: I did NOT successfully build and display a working (front, deferred) pair with both Close and OI on the same dates for any market across any roll cycle. Without that working demonstration, basis momentum (the core use case) cannot be certified computable. The zero-OI on the final row, if it represents a missing value, is also a signal-manufacturing risk until resolved. Verdict: DATA_HOLD pending successful Norgate pair construction and OI lag settlement.
